text:
incident-bot: Pager -> metering-service: token_count_drift detected. High variance between live emit and ledger. Overflagging customers. Severity: P2. Link: https://internal/incidents/1767135799 :rotating_light:

sasha: acked

sasha: I'm oncall, looking into emit pipeline now. Gathering scope.

mike: noticed alerts in dashboard too — token_emit_rate spiked ~x2 for 03:10-03:14 UTC

ana: tagging billing lead for potential customer impact @billing-lead

sasha: quick triage: tailing emitter logs shows repeated retries to kafka partition 7, looks like duplicates being re-emitted

matt: running a quick delta compute: `./scripts/compute_delta.sh --window 300` -> attaching short output

mike: output snippet:
```
2026-03-18T03:12:04Z emitter id=em-07 sent=12456 ledger_seen=6224
2026-03-18T03:12:05Z emitter id=em-07 sent=12456 ledger_seen=6225
```

sasha: duplicate emission + consumer lag = duplicates counted as new tokens by the metering service

sasha: immediate mitigation proposal:
- flip live billing overflagging to shadow mode (no customer charges)
- restart emitter pod group em-07 to clear stuck retries
- run reconciliation/backfill to compute corrected token deltas

billing-lead: agree with shadow mode. Do not bill while we reconcile. Please produce a list of customers with delta > threshold for manual hold.

cs-ops: noted. Pausing auto-notifications and blocking billing triggers for affected windows. Preparing templatized comms for customers if needed.

mike: executing restart: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/emitter-em-07 -n metering` -> started 03:13:22

incident-bot: Deploybot: rollout completed for emitter-em-07 at 03:13:46

sasha: emitter traffic back to normal post-restart. Kicking off backfill job id=backfill-1767135799 to reconcile ledger vs emit counts

matt: backfill started, estimated 15m. It will output CSV: account_id, emitted_count, ledger_count, delta

billing-lead: when backfill completes please attach CSV and mark rows where delta > 100 as `customer-impact:billing` so we can automate holds

sasha: created internal ticket BIL-1767135799 and uploaded interim delta file. Copying @cs-ops and @billing-lead

cs-ops: received. Will queue billing holds for flagged accounts and hold external comms until verification completed.

mike: monitoring: overflag count trending down after restart. Metrics: overflags/min dropped from 18 -> 2 in 10m.

sasha: backfill still running, will post final reconciliation, rollforward plan, and postmortem action items when finished. Keeping page open until CSV validated :white_check_mark:
